title: cleanup_orphan_msg_files: read_dir error aborts scan silently
description: Same pattern as cleanup_tmp_files: a single Err from next_entry() breaks the loop. Orphan .msg files listed after the failing entry are never quarantined to dead/. Those files then appear in the drain_once env scan but lack a matching .env, generating repeated 'skipping' warnings on every drain cycle instead of being quarantined once. Trigger: any directory entry error during startup scan. Bad behavior: orphan .msg accumulates in main queue dir, polluting every drain pass and obscuring the queue depth metric.
